description:
Build a one-tap link that makes a short vertical AI video of a character doing what the user describes (e.g. "Malfoid dances on the castle roof at midnight").
Use this whenever the user asks for an AI video, short, clip, TikTok/Reel/Shorts-style video, or animation of a character, avatar, mascot or persona.
Returns a URL on cast.katechon.technology. Give the URL to the user and tell them to open it and tap the button: the video renders in their private feed, usually within half a minute (a few minutes for a 2-3 character group scene). This tool does NOT generate anything, charge anything or need an account. The user's first 5-second video with a premade character (malfoid, thea, odette) is free; longer videos and custom characters cost credits (from $4.99).
For a premade character pass character="malfoid" (or "malfoid,thea" for up to 3). For anyone else pass character_name and character_description (their look) instead; the user designs the character before the video.

camera.description: Camera. auto: Let it decide; selfie: Phone-POV one-take; close-up: Faces fill the frame; wide: Big world, small figures; handheld: Breathing operator; push-in: Slow dolly in; chase: Tracking at speed; low-angle: Hero from below; overhead: God's-eye view; held: Locked-off frame. Default selfie (phone-POV livestream).

character.description: Premade character slug(s), comma-separated, up to 3: malfoid, thea, odette. Omit when using character_name/character_description.

character_description.description: The new character's look in one or two sentences: age, hair, face, clothes, vibe. Required for a good result when character_name is set.

character_name.description: Name of a NEW character to design (not one of the premade slugs).

prompt.description: What happens in the video, one line in plain words, present tense, without the character's name at the start. Concrete action + place works best: "dances on the castle roof at midnight", "reads her hate comments live and claps back".

seconds.description: Length in seconds. 5 is the free first video; up to 10 without Premium; 15 needs Premium.

style.description: Visual style. influencer: Phone-camera real; cinematic: Feature-film look; sakuga: Hand-painted anime action; glam: Fashion-week polish; vhs: Camcorder nostalgia; vlog: Warm everyday diary; dark-fantasy: Gothic myth & magic; toon3d: Animated-feature charm. Default influencer.

vibe.description: Mood and pacing. chill: Warm, low stakes; hype: Kinetic energy; dreamy: Soft and floating; eerie: Quiet dread; melancholy: Rain and distance; romantic: Tender and close; epic: Enormous scale; comedy: Snappy timing; fury: Rage with weight. Default hype.
